zh: 媒体报道目标：2027 年 Q1

en: Needs your own PS5 or Xbox
zh: 只能 Remote Play 串流
需要你自己的 PS5 或 Xbox

leader.name: ZETTROX
leader.en: Prologue control on an RTX 3050, single-digit fps. Not a playable game.
leader.zh: RTX 3050 上能操控序章，个位数帧。还不是能玩的游戏。

changes.en: PC Games Hardware reports that ZETTROX can steer Lucia through the prologue on a GeForce RTX 3050, at single-digit frame rates.
changes.zh: PC Games Hardware 报道：ZETTROX 能在 GeForce RTX 3050 上以个位数帧率操控露西亚走过序章。

changes.en: Take-Two’s DMCA notice, dated 24 Nov, took down Leonida and 3,007 repositories in that network, heise, The Verge and ComputerBase report.
changes.zh: heise、The Verge、ComputerBase 报道：Take-Two 日期为 11 月 24 日的 DMCA 通知，下架了 Leonida 及其网络中的 3007 个仓库。

changes.en: PC Gamer says GTA 6 still does not run on PC. In-game clips are hard to verify, and reported AMD shader work is still single-digit.
changes.zh: PC Gamer 称 GTA 6 在 PC 上仍然不能玩。实机片段很难核实，报道中的 AMD 着色器进展仍是个位数帧。

changes.en: PC Games Hardware reports that VIctory and XCL already load the game world. A separate lit-scene clip at about 3 fps is still unconfirmed.
changes.zh: PC Games Hardware 报道 VIctory 和 XCL 已经能加载游戏世界。另有一段约 3 帧的亮场景片段仍未证实。

changes.en: Outlets report that the missing Xbox executable is out. It is the console program, not a PC version.
changes.zh: 多家媒体报道，缺失的 Xbox 主程序已经放出。那是主机程序，不是 PC 版。

changes.en: GTA 6 launches on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Rockstar has announced no PC version.
changes.zh: GTA 6 登陆 PS5 和 Xbox Series X|S。Rockstar 没有公布 PC 版。

sources: PC Games Hardware, PC Gamer, heise, The Verge, ComputerBase, GitHub’s public DMCA notice dated 24 Nov 2026
